scope: BF16 denoiser attention on admitted Apple10/Metal4/macOS26.2+ tensors. No other backend, dtype or head-width claim.
adaptations: Retain PrefillAttnParams, mask params, Max/Sum/Mul/ExpSub operators; specialize accum type toF32 for the sole BF16 use.
Retain MPP tensor fragment/kernel body; remove unused Apple8 K fragment class. Only instantiate Apple10 BF16 D128/BQ64/BK32, one additive-mask and one unmasked entry.
Host constructs causal masks where admitted; arbitrary caller masks and other devices/dtypes/shapes fall back.
Retain Prefill pointer_element address-space trait required by typed BF16 stores; use Metal SDK METAL_FUNC macro.
Retain both PyTorch BSD and MLX MIT notices; shader header adds the combined SPDX expression and Apple copyright. No operation changed.

mlx_license_source.note: This pinned MIT notice matches the current MLX notice. It records the license text, not the revision of the later MPP kernel adapted by PyTorch.
